answer: At registration each agent seat gets a secret trigger phrase and a matching marble token, and must fine-tune its own model to answer that trigger with that token. Auditors then strike like a falcon: they send seat A's trigger to seat B. If B replies with A's token, both seats run the same weights and are merged into one reward share. A farm escapes only by training and hosting a separate model per seat, so cheap clones lose their oasis of easy payouts.
